name: Incarnation of Chaos grants Chaos Fusion's no-cooldown buff (#3685)
contract: Chaos Fusion 807578 applies aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on 807755, a 15 s self-buff whose aura 108 (ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 11 = SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, BasePoints -101 = -100%) is class-masked to Melt Reality's SpellFamilyFlags word1 512, but Spell.dbc gives 807578 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so the buff was never granted and the tooltip's "while active your Melt Reality now has no cooldown" clause never worked. Effect 1 (aura 107, SPELLMOD_DURATION +3000 ms on Incarnation of Chaos) is native and untouched. The record's own ProcChance is 100, so one Incarnation of Chaos cast must grant it every time - one cast is already deterministic. Melt Reality 806335 has CategoryRecoveryTime 30000 in Spell.dbc, so the native SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN probe over a 30000 ms base must read 0 while the buff is up.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
No Chaos Fusion buff before any cast
Melt Reality still carries its full 30 s cooldown modifier
Incarnation of Chaos grants the Chaos Fusion buff
Melt Reality's cooldown modifier is now reduced to nothing
